text_en: How unusual..._500_ The desert wind is bringing a lot of dust my way today.
Welcome, slaves._300_ Times are changing. I don't even have to bother coming down there and facing you.
Go to your “chambers” until I decide what to do with you.
Now.
Lad?
You've been asleep for a good while now._300_ I was starting to think you were dead.
I'm ashamed to admit it but, that scoundrel..._300_ I didn't even have a chance to stop him.
ARGHH!_300_ WHEN I GET OUT OF HERE I'M GONNA LINE MY SHIELD WITH HIS SKIN!
MY MEN BETTER BE IN ONE PIECE!
Breathe...
I have to find a way to get outta here and find them...
WELL DONE!
You're quite the trustworthy soldier, aren't you?

Listen, everything points towards the guy who's trapped us here being nothing more than an idiot, but perhaps he's testing us._300_ We need to get him to face us in the flesh and find out. Besides, someone like him must have information.
But I can't leave my men behind. I think splitting up would be the sort of thing General Brigard would suggest in a situation like this.
If you find them, let me know._100_ Be very careful, looks like that poodle is watching our every move.
A trap?
The walls! There has to be a way to stop them, or we'll end up as compacted junk!
Quick, climb up!_100_ Save yourself!
No..._500_ Forget it. Make this count for something._500_ But do me a favour..._100_ Save my men and tell General Brigard that I'm sorry...
I'm offended that you're so surprised, lad.
Did you think a simple stone block would prove stronger than me?
We'll talk later. Now...
FOCUS ON RIPPING THAT BUG APART!
I'm impressed, you're more resourceful than you look._100_ I'd have gone for the 'try to hack off its head until my axe broke' approach.
The dangers this place holds are no match for us, eh?
I couldn't be sure but, when the wall was pressing up against me, I noticed how the floor started to crack._100_ I was able to stomp my way through and fall to the floor below.
We should carry on with our search. We'll find that Guardian sooner or later.
Hah hah hah..._500_ So, that's what's brought you here?
What's so funny?
The tales of this world reach as far and wide as the sun's rays._100_ Of course, choosing to believe in them is another matter entirely.
It'd be easier for us to stay here and enjoy your hospitality, right?_100_ When we find you, we'll be sure to thank you in person.
I am going to great efforts to avoid coming down there and finishing you off with a click of my fingers.
You have trespassed into my domain, escaped my prison and killed my pet.
You are both beyond forgiveness. The question is... _300_ Now that's you've chosen this path, how will you die here?
Don't let his drivel get to you. He just wants to make us doubt ourselves._300_ If he had that sort of power, he would have already used it.
YOU HEAR ME, YA BIG POODLE?! IT'S NOT GONNA WORK!
I don't know where he's hiding but it doesn't look like he can get to us.
Beware of his tricks.
So, back to the original plan, then?_100_ Divide and conquer._100_ I'll save my men, whatever the cost._300_ We'll get out of here together, you'll see.
Wretched fools!_500_ Do you have any idea what it'll cost me to get hold of a collection of pets like that again?
You won't find what you seek here. Go, turn back now, but do not mistake this act for weakness._300_ A ruler must show fairness and my power is exceeded only by my magnanimity.
Leave here at once. If you ever return, I guarantee you won't receive the same compassion.
NOW!
You're back!_500_ You're just full of surprises, aren't you, lad?
So, that's it? _300_ He just kicks us out?_500_ He was nothing more than a big phoney?
ARGGGHHH!
Breathe...
I'd have preferred to make him pay._100_ We'll just have to make do with freedom. Let's get out of here, we have a report to deliver.
I think I'll add that they should put you in my regiment. What do you say? Bahahah!
Congratulations on making it this far. If you wish to live, you will have to correctly answer this question: _300_ What will you lose before leaving this room?
Incorrect._500_ You will lose everything.
Tsk..._500_ I had hoped for a little more resistance. You should thank me for ridding you of such a boring opponent.
You, however..._300_ you look much more entertaining. It's been a while since I last sliced someone up piece by piece, don't disappoint me.
You adapt..._300_ You have that instinct, just as we do...
It's you!!!_300_ Be careful, soldier. You narrowly avoided an axe to the head. We can't let our guard down in this situation.
What do you think that is?_100_ It looks like..._300_ a pair of <color=OBJ>boots</color>?_100_ Why would they leave them in a place like this?
I was brought up not to take what wasn't mine, but perhaps we should..._300_ What do you think?
Say goodbye to the outside world. You belong to me now.
